responses.question: The pinned request says “create positive non decimal to binary value,” while its acceptance criterion only says to display the binary value of 2 and take a screenshot. That leaves unclear whether the feature is general conversion or only this example, and what “non decimal” means. A conservative proposed interpretation is: convert a positive decimal input to binary, with input 2 displaying 10; screenshot is evidence for that behavior. Please confirm or correct this interpretation.
responses.answer: Confirm: convert positive decimal inputs to binary; 2 displays 10
